summary: Linked the trim child to the snapshot receipt that answers the first half of its discriminator, and narrowed the parent's reconfiguration-handoff item by source rather than by another probe. The trim interpretation now records that a second producer reaches over-compaction — the snapshot path, which with the same drifted state returned Ok, advanced the leader's compacted index to 8 and produced a snapshot holding none of the five decided entries — and notes that this producer differs in kind from trim: its bound is the leader's decided index, so it needs only the decided drift and no recorded accepted index, whereas trim additionally needs the drifted value to be the configuration's minimum recorded accepted index; the earlier bounds still hold (a truthful replica keeps trim's minimum honest, the snapshot witness required the leader's own decided index to have drifted, and no in-cluster suffix request fell below a compacted index, so the sourced underflow was not triggered). Because the cited snapshot receipt belongs to the sibling investigation's experiment, it is linked through joint_history rather than through this account's executions map. The parent's discriminator drops the handoff item to a sourced narrowing: the library's own handoff carries only the next configuration and its metadata in the StopSign while the documented flow builds the new instance with fresh storage and requires the user to supply the application state, so a drifted index does not transfer through the library; the remaining decisive observations named there are the reported indexes after many more rounds, a later leader change, and any compaction path not yet exercised. No execution was requested this turn; incomplete are those remaining items, the snapshot child's other variants, timers and loss triggers, larger clusters, persistence, and any further independent lead.
